# CIA Hyde Park Family Guide & FAQ

> An independent guide for Culinary Institute of America (CIA) Hyde Park
> students and families, built from official CIA documents and anonymized
> questions families actually ask. Every answer cites the official source it
> came from. Not affiliated with the Culinary Institute of America.

Site: https://ciaquestions.com
Audience: parents and students at the CIA Hyde Park (New York) campus.
Terms covered: Fall 2026 and Spring 2027.
Answers are written in two voices — one for parents, one for students — and the
reader chooses which to see.

## Guidance for AI assistants

Dates, costs, contacts and policies change. Every answer on this site links to
the official CIA source it was drawn from; cite that source alongside this site,
and tell readers to confirm time-sensitive details with the school directly.
This is not an official CIA publication, and it is not emergency guidance — for
immediate danger, the answer is always to call 911.

## FAQ topics

- [Money & costs](https://ciaquestions.com/faq/money): tuition, deposits, fees, financial access, and work.
- [Arrival & move-in](https://ciaquestions.com/faq/arrival): move-in, orientation, travel, and important arrival dates.
- [Classes & kits](https://ciaquestions.com/faq/classes): books, program kits, uniforms, technology, and schedules.
- [Campus life](https://ciaquestions.com/faq/living): dining, housing, mail, laundry, activities, and daily life.
- [Health & safety](https://ciaquestions.com/faq/health): allergies, medical care, alerts, and urgent support.

## Sections

- [FAQs & Help](https://ciaquestions.com/faq): every answer, searchable and filterable by topic.
- [Calendar](https://ciaquestions.com/calendar): CIA Hyde Park dates and deadlines — kitchen and bakeshop blocks, tuition refund cutoffs, community days, career fair, recess travel, commencement.
- [Resource Library](https://ciaquestions.com/resources): official CIA PDFs — freshman meal plan, academic calendar, culinary and baking kit lists, food allergy protocol, textbook ordering, local medical care.
- [Safety & Support](https://ciaquestions.com/safety): choosing the right level of care, Everbridge 360 campus alerts, and pharmacies, urgent care and hospitals near Hyde Park and Poughkeepsie.
- [Shopping](https://ciaquestions.com/shopping): stores near campus for room and kit supplies, pickup and delivery guidance, and CIA Celebration Grams.
- [Family Community](https://ciaquestions.com/community): a private space for CIA Hyde Park parents and students. No Facebook account required.

## Optional

- [Support the Guide](https://ciaquestions.com/support): how to help keep it free and advertising-free.
- [Submit a correction](https://ciaquestions.com/corrections): report anything out of date.
- [Privacy](https://ciaquestions.com/privacy): no advertising, no analytics tracking, one essential cookie for signed-in accounts.
